m: 1. मुह् cl. 4. P. (Dhātup. xxvi, 89) मुह्यति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; pf. मुमोह, Br. &c. ; मुमुहे, MBh.; aor. अमुहत्, Br.; fut. मोहिता, मोग्धा, मोढा Gr.; मोहिष्यति, Br.; मोक्ष्यति Gr.; inf. मुहे, RV.; ind.p. मोहित्वा, मुहित्वा; मुग्ध्वा, मूढ्वा Gr.; -मोहम् Gr.), to become stupefied or unconscious, be bewildered or perplexed, err, be mistaken, go astray, RV. &c., &c.; to become confused, fail, miscarry (opp. to √ कॢप्), ŚBr. &c. &c.: Caus. मोहयति (mc. also ˚ते; aor., अमूमुहत्; Pass., मोह्यते), to stupefy, bewilder, confound, perplex, cause to err or fail, RV. &c. &c.; (Ā., with अध्वानम्) to cause to go the wrong way, MBh. : Desid. मुमोहिषति, मुमुहिषति, मुमुक्षति Gr.: Intens. मोमुह्यते (MBh.), मोमोग्धि and मोमोढि (Gr.), to be greatly bewildered or perplexed.
2. मुह् (nom. मुक् or मुट्, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 33, Sch.) See मनो-मुह्.
a: मुह् — {c4c} P. (मुह्यति, मुग्ध or मूढ) 1 To faint, swoon, lose consciousness, become senseless; इहाहं द्रष्टुमाह्नं तां स्मरन्नेवं मुमोह सः Bk. 6. 21, 1. 20; 15. 16. --2 To be perplexed or bewilddered, to be disturbed in mind, be at a loss; आपत्स्वपि न मुह्यंति नराः पंडितबुद्धयः H. 1. 166, Ki. 18. 9. --3 To be foolish, stupid, or infatuated. --4 To fail. --5 To err, mistake. --Caus. (मोहयति-ते) 1 To stupefy, infatuate; मा मूमुहत्खलु भवंतमनन्यजन्मा Māl. 1. 32. --2 To confound, bewilder, perplex; Bg. 3. 2, 4. 16. --3 To throw into confusion. --4 To cause to err or mistake.

m: मुहूर्ता (आ), f. N. of a daughter of Dakṣa (wife of Dharma or Manu and mother of the Muhūrtas), Hariv.; Pur.
मुहूर्त m. n. a moment, instant, any short space of time, RV. &c. &c. (ibc., in a moment; ˚तेन ind. after an instant, presently)
a partic. division of time, the 30th part of a day, a period of 48 minutes (in pl. personified as the children of Muhūrta), ŚBr. &c. &c.
a: मुहूर्तः --र्तं — [हुर्छ् क्त ध तोः पूर्वं मुट् च Tv.] 1 A moment, any short portion of time, an instant: नवांबुदानीकमुहूर्तलांछने R. 3. 53; संध्याभ्ररेखव मुहूर्तरागाः Pt. 1. 194; Me. 19; Ku. 7. 50. --2 A period, time (auspicious or otherwise). --3 A period of 48 minutes. --र्तः An astrologer.

k.v: अष्टादश निमेषास्तु काष्ठा त्रिंशत्तु ताः कला। तास्तु त्रिंशत्क्षणस्ते तु मुहूर्तो द्वादशास्त्रियाम्.।

m: मुहूर्त—चिन्तामणि m. N. of wk. (and -सार m. -सारिणी f.)
मुहूर्त—ज (mc. for ˚ता-ज) m. pl. the children of Muhūrtā, VP.
मुहूर्तक m. or n. (?) a moment, instant, MBh.
a: मुहूर्तकः — 1 An instant, a moment. --2 A period of 48 minutes.

मुहूर्त—लक्षण-पटल m. n. N. of wk.
मुहूर्त—स्तोम m. pl. N. of a partic. Ekāha, ŚāṅkhŚr.
मुहूर्तेन ind., after an instant, presently

m: मुहुश्—चारिन् mfn. occurring repeatedly, recurring, Suśr.
मुहुक n. a moment, instant (˚कैस् ind. = prec.), RV.
मुहुर् ind. (perhaps orig. ‘in a bewildering manner’) suddenly, at once, in a moment (often with a following आ), RV.; AV.
for a moment, a while, RV. &c. &c.
at every moment, constantly, incessantly (मुहुर्-मुहुर्, now and again, at one moment and at another, again and again), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
on the other hand, on the contrary, Śak.
मुहुर्—भाषा f. repetition of what has been said, tautology, L.

k.v: अनुलापो मुहुर्भाषा विलापः परिदेवनम्. विप्रलापो विरोधोक्तिः संलापो भाषणं मिथः॥

m: मुहुर्—भुज् or मुहुर्—भोजिन्, m. ‘constantly eating’, a horse, L.

a: मुहुस् — ind. 1 Often, constantly, repeatedly, frequently; ग्रीवाभगाभिरामं मुहुरनुपतति स्यंदने दत्तदृष्टिः Ś. 1. 7, 2. 6; generally repeated in this sense; मुहुर्मुहुः over and over again, often and often; गुरुणा सन्निधानेऽपि कः कूजति मुहुर्मुहुः. --2 For a time or moment, awhile; Me. 105; generally used with successive clauses in the sense of ‘now now’, ‘at one time-at another time’; मुहुरुत्पतते बाला मुहुः पतति विह्वला . मुहुरालीयते भीता मुहुः क्रोशति रोदिति .. Subhāṣ.; Mu. 5. 3; मुहुर्तुहुः ‘again and again, repeatedly.’ --Comp. --भाषा, --वचस् n. repetition, tautology. --भुज् m. a horse.

k.v: चिराय चिररात्राय चिरस्याद्याश्चिरार्थकाः। मुहुः पुनः पुनः शश्वदभीक्ष्णमसकृत्समाः॥

मुहुस्—तनैस् ind. at repeated intervals, repeatedly, constantly, MW.
